# Proset — AI Voice Notes Recorder

Proset is a memory helper — the affordable, simpler AI voice notes recorder. When a vital idea strikes, record it and it's never lost or forgotten: Proset turns your spoken thought into a polished email, task list, or summary, on web and Android. No meeting bots, no complexity, no premium price tag.

## How it works

1. **Record** — tap the mic and talk.
2. **Transcribe** — Proset turns speech into text using cloud AI speech recognition.
3. **Use** — create emails, tasks, summaries, and more from the transcript.

## Capabilities

- **Respond to vital ideas** — a memory helper: never lose or forget a vital idea; the moment it strikes, it becomes action.
- **Voice notes to emails** — dictate and receive a polished email draft.
- **Voice notes to tasks** — extract action items from spoken thoughts.
- **Voice notes to summaries** — condense long recordings into clear takeaways.
- **Export** — download results as PDF, DOCX, CSV, Markdown, and more.
- **Your data, your way** — keep or delete recordings anytime.
- **Bilingual** — English and Spanish.
- **Web and Android** — use Proset in your browser or on Android.

## Pricing

Proset is the affordable alternative: web launch pricing is roughly half the cost of the big voice-note apps (Otter, Fireflies, Fathom, and similar run $15–20+/month).

- **Free** — try Proset with basic limits.
- **Base** — everyday use, more capacity, cloud sync add-on available.
- **Pro** — more capacity, cloud sync included.

Web launch pricing: Base $5/month (or $49.95/year), Pro $10/month (or $99.95/year); regular prices $9.99 and $19.99/month.

## FAQ

### What is Proset?
Proset is a memory helper: an affordable, simpler AI voice notes recorder that makes sure you never lose or forget a vital idea. Record it and get a polished email, task list, or summary.

### Is Proset just a voice recorder?
No — Proset goes beyond transcription. It turns recordings into actionable results: emails, tasks, and summaries.

### How is Proset different from Otter, Fireflies, or other voice note apps?
Proset is simpler — one tap record, no meeting bots or setup — and more affordable, at roughly half the price of the big voice-note apps.

### Which platforms does Proset support?
Proset works in any web browser and on Android.

### Can I export my results?
Yes — PDF, DOCX, CSV, Markdown, and more.

### Is Proset available in Spanish?
Yes — the app and documentation are available in English and Spanish (Mexican Spanish).

### What happens to my recordings?
You control them — keep or delete recordings anytime.

### Where can I learn more?
See the documentation at https://proset.ai/documentation/ or contact support at https://proset.ai/support/.
